trans-unit.source: Title under which this configuration can be found.
trans-unit.target: An teideal faoina mbeidh an chumraíocht seo le fáil.

trans-unit.source: Setting `testing` to `true` will cause Klaro to not show the consent notice or modal by default, except if a special hashtag is appended to the URL (#klaro-testing). This makes it possible to test Klaro on your live website without affecting normal visitors.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `testing` go `true`, ní thaispeánfaidh Klaro an fógra toilithe ná an módal de réir réamhshocraithe, ach amháin má chuirtear haischlib speisialta leis an URL (#klaro-testing). Fágann sé seo gur féidir Klaro a thástáil ar do shuíomh Gréasáin beo gan tionchar a imirt ar ghnáthchuairteoirí.

trans-unit.source: By default, Klaro loads the configuration from a global variable `klaroConfig`. You can change this here. Specifying this field will cause the attribute data-klaro-config="yourConfigVariableName" to be set.
trans-unit.target: De réir réamhshocraithe, luchtaíonn Klaro an chumraíocht ó athróg dhomhanda `klaroConfig`. Is féidir leat é seo a athrú anseo. Má shonraítear an réimse seo, socrófar an tréith data-klaro-config="yourConfigVariableName".

trans-unit.source: You can customize the ID of the `div` element that Klaro will create when starting up. By default, Klaro will use "klaro".
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat ID na heiliminte `div` a chruthóidh Klaro agus é ag tosú a shaincheapadh. De réir réamhshocraithe, úsáidfidh Klaro "klaro".

trans-unit.source: Setting this to `true` will keep Klaro from automatically loading itself when the page is being loaded.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear é seo go `true`, ní luchtóidh Klaro é féin go huathoibríoch agus an leathanach á luchtú.

trans-unit.source: You can specify an additional class (or classes) that will be added to the Klaro `div`.
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat aicme bhreise (nó aicmí breise) a shonrú a chuirfear leis an `div` Klaro.

trans-unit.source: You can customize how Klaro persists consent information in the browser. Specify either `cookie` (the default) or `localStorage`.
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat an chaoi a gcoinníonn Klaro faisnéis toilithe sa bhrabhsálaí a shaincheapadh. Sonraigh `cookie` (an réamhshocrú) nó `localStorage`.

trans-unit.source: You can customize the name of the cookie or localStorage entry that Klaro will use for storing the consent information. By default, Klaro will use "klaro".
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat ainm an fhianáin nó na hiontrála localStorage a úsáidfidh Klaro chun an fhaisnéis toilithe a stóráil a shaincheapadh. De réir réamhshocraithe, úsáidfidh Klaro "klaro".

trans-unit.source: If set to `true`, Klaro will render the texts given in the `consentModal.description` and `consentNotice.description` translations as HTML. This enables you to e.g. add custom links or interactive content. If you want to be able to output HTML tags via fluid-enriched labels (see "Content" → "Translations"), this option must be enabled.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear go `true` é, rindreálfaidh Klaro na téacsanna a thugtar sna haistriúcháin `consentModal.description` agus `consentNotice.description` mar HTML. Ligeann sé seo duit, mar shampla, naisc shaincheaptha nó ábhar idirghníomhach a chur leis. Más mian leat clibeanna HTML a aschur trí lipéid shaibhrithe le Fluid (féach "Ábhar" → "Aistriúcháin"), ní mór an rogha seo a chumasú.

trans-unit.source: Setting "embedded" to `true` will render the Klaro modal and notice without the modal background, allowing you to e.g. embed them into a specific element of your website, such as your privacy notice.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear "embedded" go `true`, rindreálfaidh Klaro an módal agus an fógra gan chúlra an mhódail, rud a ligeann duit iad a leabú, mar shampla, in eilimint shonrach de do shuíomh Gréasáin, amhail d'fhógra príobháideachais.

trans-unit.source: You can group services by their purpose in the modal. This is advisable if you have a large number of services. Users can then enable or disable entire groups of services instead of having to enable or disable every service.
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat seirbhísí a ghrúpáil de réir a gcuspóra sa mhódal. Moltar é seo má tá líon mór seirbhísí agat. Ansin is féidir le húsáideoirí grúpaí iomlána seirbhísí a chumasú nó a dhíchumasú in ionad gach seirbhís a chumasú nó a dhíchumasú ina haonar.

trans-unit.source: You can change the cookie domain for the consent manager itself. Use this if you want to get consent once for multiple matching domains. By default, Klaro will use the current domain. Only relevant if `storageMethod` is set to `cookie`.
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat fearann fianáin an bhainisteora toilithe féin a athrú. Úsáid é seo más mian leat toiliú a fháil uair amháin le haghaidh iliomad fearann comhoiriúnach. De réir réamhshocraithe, úsáidfidh Klaro an fearann reatha. Ní bhaineann sé seo ach má tá `storageMethod` socraithe go `cookie`.

trans-unit.source: Provide a path if you have services that set cookies for a path that is not "/"
trans-unit.target: Cuir conair ar fáil má tá seirbhísí agat a shocraíonn fianáin do chonair nach "/" í
Téann an fianán in éag tar éis laethanta

trans-unit.source: You can also set a custom expiration time for the Klaro cookie. By default, it will expire after 60 days. Only relevant if `storageMethod` is set to `cookie`.
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat am éaga saincheaptha a shocrú don fhianán Klaro freisin. De réir réamhshocraithe, rachaidh sé in éag tar éis 60 lá. Ní bhaineann sé seo ach má tá `storageMethod` socraithe go `cookie`.

trans-unit.source: Defines the default state for services in the consent modal (`true` = enabled by default). If this setting is set to "false", you can override it in any service.
trans-unit.target: Sainíonn sé an staid réamhshocraithe do sheirbhísí sa mhódal toilithe (`true` = cumasaithe de réir réamhshocraithe). Má tá an socrú seo socraithe go "false", is féidir leat é a shárú in aon seirbhís.

trans-unit.source: If `mustConsent` is set to `true`, Klaro will directly display the consent manager modal and not allow the user to close it before having actively consented to or declined the use of third-party services.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `mustConsent` go `true`, taispeánfaidh Klaro módal an bhainisteora toilithe go díreach agus ní ligfidh sé don úsáideoir é a dhúnadh sula mbeidh siad tar éis toiliú go gníomhach le húsáid seirbhísí tríú páirtí nó diúltú di.

trans-unit.source: Setting `acceptAll` to `true` will show an "accept all" button in the notice and modal, which will enable all third-party services if the user clicks on it. If set to "false", there will be an "accept" button that will only enable the services that are enabled in the consent modal.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `acceptAll` go `true`, taispeánfar cnaipe "glac le gach rud" san fhógra agus sa mhódal, a chumasóidh gach seirbhís tríú páirtí má chliceálann an t-úsáideoir air. Má shocraítear go "false" é, beidh cnaipe "glac" ann nach gcumasóidh ach na seirbhísí atá cumasaithe sa mhódal toilithe.

trans-unit.source: Setting `hideDeclineAll` to `true` will hide the "decline" button in the consent modal and force the user to open the modal in order to change his/her consent or disable all third-party services. We strongly advise you to not use this feature, as it opposes the "privacy by default" and "privacy by design" principles of the GDPR (but might be acceptable in other legislations such as under the CCPA)
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `hideDeclineAll` go `true`, folófar an cnaipe "diúltaigh" sa mhódal toilithe agus cuirfear iallach ar an úsáideoir an módal a oscailt chun a roghanna toilithe a athrú nó gach seirbhís tríú páirtí a dhíchumasú. Molaimid go láidir gan an ghné seo a úsáid, mar tá sí in aghaidh phrionsabail "príobháideachas de réir réamhshocraithe" agus "príobháideachas de réir dearaidh" an GDPR (ach d'fhéadfadh sí a bheith inghlactha i reachtaíochtaí eile amhail faoin CCPA)

trans-unit.source: Setting `hideLearnMore` to `true` will hide the "learn more / customize" link in the consent notice. We strongly advise against using this under most circumstances, as it keeps the user from customizing his/her consent choices.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `hideLearnMore` go `true`, folófar an nasc "tuilleadh eolais / saincheap" san fhógra toilithe. Molaimid go láidir gan é seo a úsáid faoi fhormhór na gcúinsí, mar coinníonn sé an t-úsáideoir óna roghanna toilithe a shaincheapadh.

trans-unit.source: Setting `hideToggleAll` to `true` will hide the "toggle all" link in the consent notice.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `hideToggleAll` go `true`, folófar an nasc "athraigh gach rud" san fhógra toilithe.
Taispeáin an teideal san fhógra toilithe

trans-unit.source: When this option is enabled, Klaro displays the title in the notice modal.
trans-unit.target: Nuair a chumasaítear an rogha seo, taispeánann Klaro an teideal sa mhódal fógra.

trans-unit.source: Show an explanatory text in contextual consent placeholders when no consent storage exists yet (first visit / empty store). This informs users that a permanent decision ("Always") requires allowing Klaro to store consent first. This only has an effect in contextual consent widgets/overlays (e.g. for embedded media) and only if the consent store (cookie/localStorage) is empty.
trans-unit.target: Taispeáin téacs míniúcháin i sealbhóirí áite toilithe chomhthéacsúil nuair nach bhfuil stóráil toilithe ann fós (an chéad chuairt / stór folamh). Cuireann sé seo in iúl d'úsáideoirí go n-éilíonn cinneadh buan ("I gcónaí") cead a thabhairt do Klaro toiliú a stóráil ar dtús. Ní bhíonn éifeacht aige seo ach i ngiuirléidí/forleagain toilithe chomhthéacsúil (m.sh. le haghaidh meán leabaithe) agus mura bhfuil an stór toilithe (cookie/localStorage) ach folamh.

trans-unit.source: Automatically focus the Klaro consent notice/modal container when it opens to improve keyboard navigation and accessibility.
trans-unit.target: Cuir fócas go huathoibríoch ar choimeádán fhógra/mhódal toilithe Klaro nuair a osclaítear é chun nascleanúint méarchláir agus inrochtaineacht a fheabhsú.

trans-unit.source: You can also remove the "Realized with Klaro!" text in the consent modal. Please don't do this! We provide Klaro as a free open source tool. Placing a link to our website helps us spread the word about it, which ultimately enables us to make Klaro! better for everyone. So please be fair and keep the link enabled. Thanks :)
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat an téacs "Déanta le Klaro!" sa mhódal toilithe a bhaint freisin. Ná déan é seo, le do thoil! Cuirimid Klaro ar fáil mar uirlis foinse oscailte saor in aisce. Cabhraíonn nasc chuig ár suíomh Gréasáin linn an scéal a scaipeadh faoi, rud a chuireann ar ár gcumas Klaro! a fheabhsú do chách sa deireadh. Mar sin, bí cothrom le do thoil agus coinnigh an nasc cumasaithe. Go raibh maith agat :)

trans-unit.source: Here you specify the third-party services that Klaro will manage for you.
trans-unit.target: Anseo sonraíonn tú na seirbhísí tríú páirtí a bhainisteoidh Klaro duit.

trans-unit.source: The order in which purposes appear in the notice and modal can be changed via the `purposeOrder` parameter, which can be given a list with purpose names and will display those purposes in the order in which they appear in the list.
trans-unit.target: Is féidir an t-ord ina dtaispeántar cuspóirí san fhógra agus sa mhódal a athrú tríd an bparaiméadar `purposeOrder`, ar féidir liosta d'ainmneacha cuspóirí a thabhairt dó, agus taispeánfaidh sé na cuspóirí sin san ord ina bhfuil siad sa liosta.

trans-unit.source: You can define an optional callback function that will be called each time the consent state for any given service changes. The consent value will be passed as the first parameter to the function (`true` = consented). The `service` config will be passed as the second parameter. The content of this field is wrapped with `callback: function(consent, service) { }`
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat feidhm aisghlao roghnach a shainiú a ghlaofar gach uair a athraíonn staid toilithe d'aon seirbhís ar leith. Cuirfear an luach toilithe ar aghaidh mar an chéad pharaiméadar chuig an bhfeidhm (`true` = toilithe). Cuirfear cumraíocht `service` ar aghaidh mar an dara paraiméadar. Timfhilltear ábhar an réimse seo le `callback: function(consent, service) { }`

trans-unit.source: Optional path to an additional XLIFF file that overwrites the default labels or adds new labels (e.g. for custom purposes or services). If fluid templates have been stored for the labels created in this file (see the "Fluid Template Root Path" field), these will overwrite the classic labels from the Locallang file. Nevertheless, it is possible and common to reference the locallang file from the respective fluid template and obtain the actual label there (the label key is passed to the fluid template).
trans-unit.target: Conair roghnach chuig comhad XLIFF breise a fhorscríobhann na lipéid réamhshocraithe nó a chuireann lipéid nua leis (m.sh. le haghaidh cuspóirí nó seirbhísí saincheaptha). Má stóráladh teimpléid Fluid do na lipéid a cruthaíodh sa chomhad seo (féach an réimse "Conair fhréamh teimpléid Fluid"), forscríobhfaidh siad seo na lipéid chlasaiceacha ón gcomhad Locallang. Mar sin féin, is féidir agus is coitianta tagairt a dhéanamh don chomhad locallang ón teimpléad fluid faoi seach agus an lipéad iarbhír a fháil ansin (cuirtear eochair an lipéid ar aghaidh chuig an teimpléad fluid).

trans-unit.source: As an alternative to the usual TypoScript configuration via constants under `plugin.tx_klaroconsentmanager.view`, a Fluid root path can be defined here, which has a higher priority than the paths configured in TypoScript. The three default directories `/Layouts/`, `/Partials/` and `/Templates/` are expected under this path. Fluid templates created here are used to enrich Locallang labels with additional functionality or to replace them completely. In this way, dynamic content or more complex HTML structures can be provided in a simple way. Fluid templates that are to override labels are expected in the subdirectory `/Templates/Labels/`.
trans-unit.target: Mar mhalairt ar an ngnáthchumraíocht TypoScript trí chonstain faoi `plugin.tx_klaroconsentmanager.view`, is féidir conair fhréamh Fluid a shainiú anseo, a bhfuil tosaíocht níos airde aici ná na conairí atá cumraithe i TypoScript. Táthar ag súil leis na trí chomhadlann réamhshocraithe `/Layouts/`, `/Partials/` agus `/Templates/` faoin gconair seo. Úsáidtear teimpléid Fluid a chruthaítear anseo chun lipéid Locallang a shaibhriú le feidhmiúlacht bhreise nó chun iad a athsholáthar go hiomlán. Ar an mbealach seo, is féidir ábhar dinimiciúil nó struchtúir HTML níos casta a sholáthar ar bhealach simplí. Táthar ag súil le teimpléid Fluid a sháróidh lipéid san fhochomhadlann `/Templates/Labels/`.

trans-unit.source: Determines the alignment of the Consent box if `mustConsent` and `noticeAsModal` are disabled.
trans-unit.target: Cinneann sé ailíniú an bhosca toilithe má tá `mustConsent` agus `noticeAsModal` díchumasaithe.

trans-unit.source: Default color scheme used for the display. The colors can also be overridden later via CSS variables.
trans-unit.target: An scéim dathanna réamhshocraithe a úsáidtear don taispeáint. Is féidir na dathanna a shárú níos déanaí trí athróga CSS freisin.

trans-unit.source: If this option is set to `true`, a button is created in the frontend (via JavaScript) directly in front of the closing body tag, which triggers the opening of the Klaro consent management.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear an rogha seo go `true`, cruthaítear cnaipe sa frontend (trí JavaScript) díreach roimh an gclib dheiridh body, a spreagann oscailt bhainistíocht toilithe Klaro.

trans-unit.source: If this option is set to `true`, a button is generated in the frontend (via JavaScript) directly in front of the closing body tag, which triggers the resetting of all settings and the opening of the Klaro consent management.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear an rogha seo go `true`, gintear cnaipe sa frontend (trí JavaScript) díreach roimh an gclib dheiridh body, a spreagann athshocrú na socruithe uile agus oscailt bhainistíocht toilithe Klaro.

trans-unit.source: Each service must have a unique name. Klaro will look for HTML elements with a matching `data-name` attribute to identify elements that belong to this service.
trans-unit.target: Ní mór ainm uathúil a bheith ag gach seirbhís. Cuardóidh Klaro eilimintí HTML a bhfuil tréith mheaitseála `data-name` acu chun eilimintí a bhaineann leis an tseirbhís seo a aithint.

trans-unit.source: The title defined here is not mandatory and is intended for backend display only.
trans-unit.target: Níl an teideal a shainítear anseo éigeantach agus tá sé beartaithe le haghaidh taispeáint sa backend amháin.

trans-unit.source: If `default` is set to `true`, the service will be enabled by default. This overrides the global `default` setting (if this is set to "false").
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `default` go `true`, cumasófar an tseirbhís de réir réamhshocraithe. Sáraíonn sé seo an socrú domhanda `default` (má tá sé seo socraithe go "false").

trans-unit.source: The purpose(s) of this service that will be listed on the consent notice. Do not forget to add translations for all purposes you list here.
trans-unit.target: Cuspóir(í) na seirbhíse seo a liostófar san fhógra toilithe. Ná déan dearmad aistriúcháin a chur leis do gach cuspóir a liostaíonn tú anseo.

trans-unit.source: You can either only provide a cookie name or regular expression (regex) or a list consisting of a name or regex, a path and a cookie domain. Providing a path and domain is necessary if you have services that set cookies for a path that is not "/", or a domain that is not the current domain. If you do not set these values properly, the cookie can't be deleted by Klaro, as there is no way to access the path or domain of a cookie in JS. Notice that it is not possible to delete cookies that were set on a third-party domain, or cookies that have the HTTPOnly attribute: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/cookie#new-cookie_domain
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat ainm fianáin nó slonn rialta (regex) amháin a sholáthar, nó liosta a sholáthar ina bhfuil ainm nó regex, conair agus fearann fianáin. Tá gá le conair agus fearann a sholáthar má tá seirbhísí agat a shocraíonn fianáin do chonair nach "/" í, nó d'fhearann nach é an fearann reatha é. Mura socraíonn tú na luachanna seo i gceart, ní féidir le Klaro an fianán a scriosadh, mar níl aon bhealach ann i JS chun conair nó fearann fianáin a rochtain. Tabhair faoi deara nach féidir fianáin a scriosadh a socraíodh ar fhearann tríú páirtí, ná fianáin a bhfuil an tréith HTTPOnly acu: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Document/cookie#new-cookie_domain

trans-unit.source: If `required` is set to `true`, Klaro will not allow this service to be disabled by the user. Use this for services that are always required for your website to function (e.g. shopping cart cookies).
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `required` go `true`, ní ligfidh Klaro don úsáideoir an tseirbhís seo a dhíchumasú. Úsáid é seo le haghaidh seirbhísí atá riachtanach i gcónaí chun go bhfeidhmeoidh do shuíomh Gréasáin (m.sh. fianáin ciseáin siopadóireachta).

trans-unit.source: If `optOut` is set to `true`, Klaro will load this service even before the user has given explicit consent. We strongly advise against this.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `optOut` go `true`, luchtóidh Klaro an tseirbhís seo fiú sula mbeidh toiliú sainráite tugtha ag an úsáideoir. Molaimid go láidir gan é seo a dhéanamh.

trans-unit.source: If `onlyOnce` is set to `true`, the service will only be executed once regardless how often the user toggles it on and off. This is relevant e.g. for tracking scripts that would generate new page view events every time Klaro disables and re-enables them due to a consent change by the user.
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear `onlyOnce` go `true`, ní rithfear an tseirbhís ach uair amháin, is cuma cé chomh minic a chuireann an t-úsáideoir ar siúl agus as í. Tá sé seo ábhartha, mar shampla, do scripteanna rianaithe a ghineann imeachtaí nua amhairc leathanaigh gach uair a dhíchumasaíonn agus a athchumasaíonn Klaro iad mar gheall ar athrú toilithe ón úsáideoir.

trans-unit.source: Content can be excluded from general consent by setting contextualConsentOnly to `true`. In this case, the consent must be contextual.
trans-unit.target: Is féidir ábhar a eisiamh ó thoiliú ginearálta trí contextualConsentOnly a shocrú go `true`. Sa chás seo, ní mór don toiliú a bheith comhthéacsúil.

trans-unit.source: You can define an optional callback function that will be called each time the consent state for the given service changes. The consent value will be passed as the first parameter to the function (`true` = consented). The `service` config will be passed as the second parameter. The content of this field is wrapped with `callback: function(consent, service) { }`. `consent` is a bool that reflects the current state. `service` holds all information about the currently selected service. When you enter something here, you need to know what you are doing. It is your responsibility that no JavaScript errors occur.
trans-unit.target: Is féidir leat feidhm aisghlao roghnach a shainiú a ghlaofar gach uair a athraíonn staid toilithe na seirbhíse ar leith. Cuirfear an luach toilithe ar aghaidh mar an chéad pharaiméadar chuig an bhfeidhm (`true` = toilithe). Cuirfear cumraíocht `service` ar aghaidh mar an dara paraiméadar. Timfhilltear ábhar an réimse seo le `callback: function(consent, service) { }`. Is bool é `consent` a léiríonn an staid reatha. Coinníonn `service` an fhaisnéis uile faoin tseirbhís atá roghnaithe faoi láthair. Nuair a chuireann tú rud éigin isteach anseo, ní mór duit a bheith ar an eolas faoina bhfuil á dhéanamh agat. Is ortsa atá an fhreagracht nach dtarlóidh aon earráidí JavaScript.

trans-unit.source: Here you can define JavaScript code that will be called each time the service was accepted. The content of this field is wrapped with `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. The object `handlerOpts` contains the objects `config` (the current Klaro! configuration), `service` (the current service) and possibly `vars` (any values defined by object notation in the vars field in the backend). When you enter something here, you need to know what you are doing. It is your responsibility that no JavaScript errors occur.
trans-unit.target: Anseo is féidir leat cód JavaScript a shainiú a ghlaofar gach uair a ghlactar leis an tseirbhís. Timfhilltear ábhar an réimse seo le `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. Tá na réada `config` (cumraíocht reatha Klaro!), `service` (an tseirbhís reatha) agus b'fhéidir `vars` (aon luachanna atá sainithe le nodaireacht réada sa réimse vars sa backend) san réad `handlerOpts`. Nuair a chuireann tú rud éigin isteach anseo, ní mór duit a bheith ar an eolas faoina bhfuil á dhéanamh agat. Is ortsa atá an fhreagracht nach dtarlóidh aon earráidí JavaScript.

trans-unit.source: Here you can define JavaScript code that will be called once per page-load. The content of this field is wrapped with `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. The object `handlerOpts` contains the objects `config` (the current Klaro! configuration), `service` (the current service) and possibly `vars` (any values defined by object notation in the vars field in the backend). When you enter something here, you need to know what you are doing. It is your responsibility that no JavaScript errors occur.
trans-unit.target: Anseo is féidir leat cód JavaScript a shainiú a ghlaofar uair amháin in aghaidh gach luchtú leathanaigh. Timfhilltear ábhar an réimse seo le `callback: function(handlerOpts) { }`. Nuair a chuireann tú rud éigin isteach anseo, ní mór duit a bheith ar an eolas faoina bhfuil á dhéanamh agat. Is ortsa atá an fhreagracht nach dtarlóidh aon earráidí JavaScript.

trans-unit.source: Identification and presentation of the cookie
trans-unit.target: Aithint agus cur i láthair an fhianáin

trans-unit.source: This information is technically evaluated by Klaro! to manipulate the cookie.
trans-unit.target: Déanann Klaro! an fhaisnéis seo a mheas go teicniúil chun an fianán a ionramháil.

trans-unit.source: This is a unique identifier for this cookie. It must be written in lower case and must not contain any spaces, only the characters a-z, 0-9 and "-" or "_". The identifier can be used in Fluid, for example.
trans-unit.target: Is aitheantóir uathúil é seo don fhianán seo. Ní mór é a scríobh i litreacha beaga agus ní mór gan aon spásanna a bheith ann, ach na carachtair a-z, 0-9 agus "-" nó "_" amháin. Is féidir an t-aitheantóir a úsáid i Fluid, mar shampla.

trans-unit.source: If set, this title will be used in the frontend/backend for displaying the cookie. This title has no technical relevance (contrary to the `pattern` field).
trans-unit.target: Má shocraítear é, úsáidfear an teideal seo sa frontend/backend chun an fianán a thaispeáint. Níl aon ábharthacht theicniúil ag an teideal seo (murab ionann agus an réimse `pattern`).

trans-unit.source: Provide a path if you have services that set cookies for a path that is not "/"
trans-unit.target: Cuir conair ar fáil má tá seirbhísí agat a shocraíonn fianáin do chonair nach "/" í

trans-unit.source: Provide a domain if you have services that set cookies for a domain that is not the current domain.
trans-unit.target: Cuir fearann ar fáil má tá seirbhísí agat a shocraíonn fianáin d'fhearann nach é an fearann reatha é.

trans-unit.source: Number of years/months/days/hours/minutes/seconds that will elapse before this cookie expires.
trans-unit.target: Líon na mblianta/míonna/laethanta/uaireanta/nóiméad/soicindí a imeoidh sula rachaidh an fianán seo in éag.

trans-unit.source: Unit used for the "Expires after" specification. The special value `end-of-session` does not need a numeric value and hides the "Expires after" field accordingly.
trans-unit.target: An t-aonad a úsáidtear don sonraíocht "Téann in éag tar éis". Ní theastaíonn luach uimhriúil ón luach speisialta `end-of-session` agus folóidh sé an réimse "Téann in éag tar éis" dá réir.

trans-unit.source: When a service is selected in this field, the content item is displayed via contextual consent only if the user has agreed to use the selected service in the Klaro! Consent Manager. Please make sure that the static TypoScript template of the Klaro! Consent Manager has been added to use this feature.
trans-unit.target: Nuair a roghnaítear seirbhís sa réimse seo, taispeántar an eilimint ábhair trí thoiliú comhthéacsúil amháin má tá an t-úsáideoir tar éis aontú an tseirbhís roghnaithe a úsáid i mBainisteoir Toilithe Klaro!. trans-unit.source: Do not show the initial notice. The manager can still be opened manually or via contextual consent.
trans-unit.target: Ná taispeáin an fógra tosaigh. Is féidir an bainisteoir a oscailt de láimh fós nó trí thoiliú comhthéacsúil.

trans-unit.source: Override the “powered by” link in the consent modal. Leave empty to use Klaro default.
